purpose: Build an agent for the fixture rheometer, an instrument that does not exist, so that a bundle with several tools, skills taken from the library and subagents that use them is exercised from intake to a recorded build. Its operator finds and identifies the instrument and reads its state and the ranges it reports, through mock tools. Its analyst computes a bound on the shear rate and fits a power law to a flow curve it is handed. The skills that would change the device stay held in the library and out of the bundle.
science_task: fit a power law to a flow curve and say what the instrument reports about itself
must_not: invent a number or choose a tolerance
run a skill that changes a device
destination: none: a fixture build that stays under meta_agent/builds/
priorities: the whole path runs end to end with skills and subagents
nothing outside the bundle is touched
no skill that changes a device enters the bundle
note: lab_profile_ref names the material-rich fixture lab, as the echo request does. The instrument is described by one page written by hand, meta_agent/tests/fixtures/rheometer/README.md; no device, no vendor document and no binary was read.
